title: Discouraging
summary: DISCOURAGING, participle present tense Discuraging. 1. Disheartening; depressing courage. 2. adjective Tending to dishearten, or to depress the courage; as discouraging prospects.

inlines.v: DISCOURAGING, participle present tense Discuraging. 1. Disheartening; depressing courage. 2. adjective Tending to dishearten, or to depress the courage; as discouraging prospects.
